execute.name: execute
execute.description: Execute one exact RustJunosMCP operation. Copy a name from the operation enum and pass its arguments unchanged.

operation.description:
add_device: Add a Junos device to the in-memory inventory and persist to devices.json. required: none
apply_junos_change_set: Apply an approved change set to the device. required: change_set_id and expected_digest and expected_fingerprint and (device or router_name or router)
approve_junos_change_set: Approve a change set created by a different principal. required: change_set_id and expected_digest and (device or router_name or router)
cancel_junos_change_set: Cancel a Planned or Approved change set, freeing the per-principal pending slot. required: change_set_id and (device or router_name or router)
check_srx_feature_license: Check whether a named SRX security feature (IDP, AppID, UTM Antivirus, Web Filtering, Anti-Spam, SecIntel, ATP Cloud, SSL Proxy) has a valid license installed on the device. required: feature and (router or router_name)
collect_jtac_support_bundle: Collects a JTAC-ready diagnostic bundle for the named router. required: problem_type and (router or router_name)
commit_check_config: Validate a candidate configuration on a Junos device without committing (commit check). required: config_text and (device or router_name or router)
confirm_junos_change_set: Confirm a provisional commit made with confirm_timeout_mins, cancelling the device's automatic rollback. required: operation_id and (device or router_name or router)
create_junos_change_set: Create a change set (plan) for two-person approval workflow. required: expected_fingerprint and actions and (device or router_name or router)
discard_candidate: Discard uncommitted candidate configuration changes on a Junos device (rollback 0), returning the candidate to the running config. required: (device or router_name or router)
execute_junos_command: Execute a Junos command on the device. required: command and (device or router_name or router)
execute_junos_command_batch: Run N operational CLI commands across M devices, parallel across devices, sequential per device. required: commands and (devices or routers or router or router_name) and none
execute_junos_pfe_command: Execute a single PFE-shell command on one device via 'request pfe execute target <fpc> command "<cmd>"'. required: fpc_target and pfe_command and (device or router_name or router)
fetch_file: Download a file from a Junos device's /var/tmp/<basename> to the host staging directory, with sha256 verification. required: remote_path and (device or router_name or router)
gather_device_facts: Gather Junos device facts from the device. required: (device or router_name or router)
get_chassis_cluster_status: Chassis-cluster topology + health snapshot. required: (router or router_name)
get_device_list: Get the Junos devices visible to this caller. required: none
get_junos_candidate_fingerprint: Read the device's candidate-configuration fingerprint. required: (device or router_name or router)
get_junos_change_set_status: Get the status of a change set. required: change_set_id and (device or router_name or router)
get_junos_config: Get the configuration of the device. required: (device or router_name or router) and none
get_router_list: DEPRECATED: Use get_device_list instead. required: none
get_srx_security_services_status: Reports the health and version of up to five SRX security services (IDP, AppID, UTM Anti-Virus, SecIntel, ATP/AAMW) in a single call. required: (router or router_name)
junos_config_diff: Get the configuration diff against a rollback version. required: (device or router_name or router)
list_junos_change_sets: List change sets, optionally filtered by device. required: none and none and none
list_staged_files: List host-staging files (always); also lists /var/tmp/ on a Junos device when device is supplied. required: none and none and none
load_and_commit_config: Load and commit configuration on a Junos device. required: config_text and (device or router_name or router)
manage_appid_signature_package: DESTRUCTIVE on the `download_and_install` and `uninstall` actions: updates or removes the AppID application signature package on an SRX device. required: action and (router or router_name)
manage_idp_security_package: DESTRUCTIVE on the `download_and_install` and `rollback` actions: updates / reverts the IDP signature package on an SRX device. required: action and (router or router_name)
reload_devices: Reload the inventory. required: none
render_and_apply_j2_template: Render a Jinja2 template (inline) with JSON vars. required: template_content and vars_content and none and none and none and none
rollback_config: Load a Junos rollback archive (rollback N, 0-49) into the candidate. required: version and (device or router_name or router)
srxmcp_status: Diagnostic — returns this server's version, endpoint name, and uptime in seconds. required: none
transfer_file: Push a local file from the staging dir to /var/tmp/ on a Junos device via SCP. required: source_path and (device or router_name or router)
upgrade_junos: DESTRUCTIVE: installs a new Junos image and REBOOTS the device. required: source_path and target_version and (device or router_name or router)
validate_chassis_cluster_health: Runs 8 chassis-cluster diagnostic RPCs (cluster status, interfaces, information, data-plane / control-plane statistics, per-RE software, alarms, uptime) and emits an ordered findings list with a rolled-up verdict (pass / warn / fail). required: (router or router_name)
vpn_lifecycle_report: Correlates IKE (Phase-1) and IPsec (Phase-2) security associations for VPN troubleshooting. required: (router or router_name)

arguments.description: Pass the selected operation's arguments unchanged. Use its exact argument names.
